free_tier.stated: No paid fee. The vendor's privilege page lists, for a non-member, 10GB of cloud drive space, 5GB/month of high-speed cloud-drive download traffic and 3 remote downloads per day on a NAS client; its speed graphic lists 586 KB/s for the un-membered path, so the free account has a small cloud allowance but no cloud-add product at the scale of the paid tiers.
free_tier.notes: The free path is not byte-metered; it is shaped. 586 KB/s is 50.6 GB/day, or about 1.5 TB/month if the client leaves the machine running.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published on the vendor's privilege page; the non-member cloud drive holds 10GB in total.

retention.stated: Cloud drive recycle bin: deleted files are kept 10 days for a non-member and for longer on the paid tiers. How long a non-member's files stay in the drive itself is not published.

egress.terms: Unmetered and shaped. The vendor table puts the un-membered path at 586 KB/s against 15.8 MB/s for 超级会员, a 27x difference on the same file.

interface_detail: The same vendor client, without the membership features.
tooling: Vendor client; the free path is a user's ordinary HTTP/BT downloader.
chaining: The free path is the fallback when no membership is held: 1.5 TB/month is reachable in principle, but only by leaving a machine on for the whole month; the non-member cloud allowances (10GB of drive space, 5GB/month of high-speed download traffic) are too small to act as a server-side fetch at volume.

limits.value: 586 KB/s per the vendor speed table; no byte counter
non-member: 5GB/month of high-speed cloud-drive download traffic (白金会员: 1TB/month); once used, cloud-drive downloads run at ordinary speed

limits_note: NAS-client remote download: unlimited for the paid tiers, 3 per day for a non-member.

identity_cost.detail: Same account system as 超级会员: phone plus 微信/QQ QR. Unverified beyond that.

reliability_note: The 27x gap is the product. The un-membered client path is shaped rather than byte-capped; the cloud-side features carry small non-member allowances (10GB of drive space, 5GB/month of high-speed download traffic).
confidence_note: The 586 KB/s figure and the non-member cloud allowances are read from the vendor's privilege page. The speed graphic lists the three figures in the order of the tiers shown; a timed download on a free account would make the speed measured.

notes: Free-tier retrieval through 迅雷 is not a debrid-equivalent: the non-member cloud allowances are small (10GB of drive space, 5GB/month of high-speed download traffic). The value of this record is the 27x number, which prices every other accelerator in the market.
binding_note: The free client path is shaped at 586 KB/s with no byte counter, so the shaping is the measurable ceiling. The cloud-side non-member allowances (10GB of drive space, 5GB/month of high-speed download traffic, 3 NAS remote downloads per day) are too small for server-side retrieval of large volumes.
